content_based_deduplication.description: Enables content-based deduplication for FIFO queues

create_dlq.description: Not supported (gap): the dead-letter queue (create_dlq); make it its own component

create_queue_policy.description: Whether to create SQS queue policy

deduplication_scope.description: Specifies whether message deduplication occurs at the message group or queue level

delay_seconds.description: The time in seconds that the delivery of all messages in the queue will be delayed. An integer from 0 to 900 (15 minutes)

fifo_throughput_limit.description: Specifies whether the FIFO queue throughput quota applies to the entire queue or per message group

kms_data_key_reuse_period_seconds.description: The length of time, in seconds, for which Amazon SQS can reuse a data key to encrypt or decrypt messages before calling AWS KMS again

kms_master_key_id.description: The ID of an AWS-managed customer master key (CMK) for Amazon SQS or a custom CMK

max_message_size.description: The limit of how many bytes a message can contain before Amazon SQS rejects it. An integer from 1024 bytes (1 KiB) up to 1048576 bytes (1024 KiB)

message_retention_seconds.description: The number of seconds Amazon SQS retains a message. Integer representing seconds, from 60 (1 minute) to 1209600 (14 days)

name.description: This is the human-readable name of the queue (required, or names.queue: Terraform's random name would change between renders)

override_dlq_queue_policy_documents.description: Not supported (gap): the dead-letter queue (create_dlq); make it its own component

override_queue_policy_documents.description: List of IAM policy documents that are merged together into the exported document. In merging, statements with non-blank `sid`s will override statements with the same `sid`

queue_policy_statements.description: A map of IAM policy statements for custom permission usage

receive_wait_time_seconds.description: The time for which a ReceiveMessage call will wait for a message to arrive (long polling) before returning. An integer from 0 to 20 (seconds)

redrive_allow_policy.description: The JSON policy to set up the Dead Letter Queue redrive permission, see AWS docs

redrive_policy.description: The JSON policy to set up the Dead Letter Queue, see AWS docs

region.description: Region where the resource(s) will be managed (the services.k8s.aws/region annotation); unset, the namespace's or the controller's

source_dlq_queue_policy_documents.description: Not supported (gap): the dead-letter queue (create_dlq); make it its own component

source_queue_policy_documents.description: List of IAM policy documents that are merged together into the exported document. Statements must have unique `sid`s

sqs_managed_sse_enabled.description: Boolean to enable server-side encryption (SSE) of message content with SQS-owned encryption keys

tags.description: A mapping of tags to assign to all resources

use_name_prefix.description: Not supported: a queue name with Terraform's random suffix (name_prefix) would change between renders; set name (the namePrefix value keeps two Instances' queues apart)

visibility_timeout_seconds.description: The visibility timeout for the queue. An integer from 0 to 43200 (12 hours)
